title: BeerSmith Batch Status Mix
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(batch_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the BeerSmith batch feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `batch_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates the overall mood of your BeerSmith batch feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
